source_snapshot.procedure: 【Before Test】 verify SUT configuration and clear logs. 【During Test】 send in-band `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x01` on localhost; check completion code 00 and Byte 2 Device ID, Byte 3 Device Revision, Bytes 4-5 BMC Firmware Version, Byte 6 IPMI version, Byte 7 Additional Device Support, Bytes 8-10 Manufacturer ID, Bytes 11-12 Product ID. 【After Test】 collect results/photos and check logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without any error.

original_test_intent: Issue the in-band IPMI Get Device ID request and validate the returned BMC identity/version/support fields and successful completion.
original_method: Run raw netfn 0x06 command 0x01 locally through the approved in-band interface, capture the exact response and decode every specified byte against the Project BMC reference.
manual_activity: No intrinsic manual step is required once target, reference values and parser schema are supplied; engineer reviews exceptions and owns the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Approved in-band interface and ipmitool version
safety_requirements: Do not use sshpass or disable host-key verification.
Reject nonzero completion, short response or ambiguous endianness.
Do not substitute mc info for wire-response evidence.
No alternative raw command or automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Issue one bounded read-only Get Device ID request.
Validate completion and response length, then decode every specified field.
Compare to reference and return raw/structured evidence without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve expected identity/version reference and parser schema.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The raw request is applicable, but the SSH wrapper is unsafe and the `mc info` log label is not equivalent. A protected local/verified session and exact raw parser are required.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved local execution or verified secret-safe host access to run `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x01` once with timeout, then parse raw bytes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NetFn 0x06, command 0x01, byte fields, Script and 10/5-minute values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bounded protected raw query plus versioned byte decoder and reference comparison.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Project host with in-band access to the intended BMC.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: IPMI Get Device ID response layout plus vendor/Project identity values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure target handling and objective parsing without changing the command or coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An optional `mc info` correlation is supplemental and cannot replace the raw response.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong endianness can silently misidentify manufacturer/product IDs.

project_override_considerations: A Project-approved library or vendor client may issue the same Get Device ID request if raw completion and all bytes remain available; summarized inventory alone is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Verified DUT/BMC and in-band interface identity
Tool/parser versions and redacted exact raw bytes
Reference comparison, no-mutation audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source command and listed response fields consistently describe IPMI Get Device ID; the DeepSeek mc-info label is a review defect, not a Master conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: All test operations are deterministic and read-only; missing target/reference/schema data are normal execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Provides byte-level, reproducible acceptance and prevents a different high-level command from being mistaken for the required raw response.
independent_technical_reasoning: The operation has no physical/manual dependency: target validation, invocation, completion/length checking, endian-aware decoding and comparison are all machine-verifiable. Human ownership of the final verdict does not reduce its automation capability, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is appropriate.
